aggregate_policy: A controlling gate with status WARN or BLOCKED keeps the evidence-grade aggregate at WARN; no averaging may hide it.

gates.definition: Public wording does not outrun Claim Class C evidence.
gates.current_evidence: Current allowed/blocked wording is machine-readable; no promotion is authorized.
gates.claim_effect: Keeps strategy/social and law/causal language blocked.

gates.definition: Every primary and robustness series has upstream identity, URL, terms, release, local path, coverage, and hash.
gates.current_evidence: Frozen U.S. primary panel is source-locked; global and optional asset/history inputs remain open.

gates.definition: Release vintage and as-of date are locked and revisions are not mixed across panels.
gates.current_evidence: U.S. baseline vintage is frozen; global and future releases are not yet locked.

gates.definition: Market/asset inputs have explicit licensing and redistribution terms.
gates.current_evidence: Licensed LBMA and S&P/CRSP exports are absent; Yahoo price-only files are quarantined.
gates.claim_effect: Asset lane cannot support a peg or superiority claim.

gates.definition: Units, deflators, PPP, currencies, index bases, and heat-content conversions close without ambiguity.
gates.current_evidence: Current U.S. panel closes operational units; literal density and global PPP remain open.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks literal energy-density and pooled global comparisons.

gates.definition: Each construct has validity evidence, at least three declared operationalizations, and measurement-error sensitivity.
gates.current_evidence: R/N/K/I are heuristic proxies; construct validity is not closed.
gates.claim_effect: Keeps R=N+K+I at diagnostic proxy status.

gates.definition: Coverage and missingness are reported by series/country and primary evidence has no silent imputation.
gates.current_evidence: U.S. primary panel has no imputation; global and welfare expansions are not yet packaged.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks distributional/global generalization when coverage is incomplete.

gates.definition: Transformations are fitted only with information available at each origin and revision leakage is tested.
gates.current_evidence: Existing rolling-origin policy is present; a full real-time-vintage audit is pending.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks predictive wording until leakage closure.

gates.definition: A candidate signal must beat both named baselines by the preregistered threshold with a bootstrap interval below zero.
gates.current_evidence: Current resource and mismatch candidates do not pass the declared baseline rule; this is a valid negative diagnostic result.

gates.definition: Causal identification requires pre-trends, placebo/negative controls, instrument strength, and independent designs.
gates.current_evidence: Current package is descriptive and non-causal.
gates.claim_effect: Fiat, policy, energy-shock, and wage-causality language remains blocked.

gates.definition: Independent rerun and cross-country replication reproduce the frozen package from source archives.
gates.current_evidence: No independent rerun or global replication is complete.
gates.claim_effect: No external-validity or general-law claim is allowed.

gates.definition: Human-reviewed formula/data/result/claim package is complete and limitations are explicit.
gates.current_evidence: Internal package is auditable; human review and publication package are pending.
gates.claim_effect: Evidence Grade A is not reached.
